discovery.proof_rule: offset 1170 resolved and offset 1171 returned an empty repository list

recruiter_portfolio.purpose: High-signal recruiter portfolio. Membership does not imply identical proof level.

priority_spine.purpose: Policy, presentation, governance, engineering, intelligence, and consolidation authorities.

owned_library.purpose: Complete owner-accessible library boundary. Inventory does not establish authorship, production readiness, deployment, or recruiter inclusion.

classification_policy.canonical_evidence: Repository-native proof and a governed inclusion decision are both required.
classification_policy.candidate_expansion: Newly discovered repository with plausible portfolio relevance; no résumé claim until inspected and verified.
classification_policy.supporting_or_upstream: Tool, framework, mirror, educational source, or dependency context; does not become authored candidate evidence by ownership alone.
classification_policy.private_or_sensitive: Excluded from public recruiter surfaces unless a separate bounded public exhibit is intentionally created.
classification_policy.archive_backup_or_fork: Retained for provenance or research and excluded from recruiter counts by default.

mutation_policy.reason: Repository mutation requires per-repository discovery, unique-value preservation, native verification, and an auditable merge or receipt.

nonclaims: The 1171-repository census is not a claim that 1171 repositories were authored from scratch.
The census is not a claim that every repository is production-ready, tested, deployed, secure, or recruiter-relevant.
Candidate expansion entries are not part of the exact 66-repository recruiter portfolio until separately promoted.
No child repository was overwritten or mass-merged by this census operation.
